original_test_intent: Change one explicitly approved per-sensor event-message or scanning control on a dedicated target, verify the exact resulting mask and bounded event behavior, then restore the complete prior state.
original_method: Master remains TBD. Review identifies IPMI v2.0 Table 35-10 raw 0x04/0x28 with sensor number, a control byte and only the assertion/deassertion selection bytes required by the approved change.
manual_activity: The monitoring owner approves the dedicated target, sensor, exact global/scanning/individual-control intent, selected assertion/deassertion events, bounded stimulus, maintenance window and byte-for-byte restore.
required_inputs: Verified BMC, channel, sensor number and matched SDR
SDR Sensor Event Message Control Support and event masks
Approved threshold-event or discrete-state assertion/deassertion selection masks
Exact restore payload and independent recovery owner
safety_requirements: Preserve SEL, BMC and OS evidence
Do not guess sensor capability or reserved bits
Do not disable scanning unless that distinct effect is explicitly approved
Do not conflate disabling all event messages with changing individual enables
Issue one approved write and verify with 0x29
Stop on event storm, monitoring loss or competing policy writer
Restore and reverify the full baseline
agent_execution_scope: Verify sensor identity, SDR event-control capability and supported event bits
Capture raw 0x04/0x29 baseline plus event/log state
Decode the proposed control byte into global event-message, scanning and individual-enable effects
Present the exact variable-length payload and byte diff for confirmation
Read back with 0x04/0x29 and exercise only the approved bounded event
Restore the captured baseline and reverify
engineer_actions: Approve the exact control scope, event masks, stimulus and maintenance window
Own recovery if monitoring or restore fails

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses the TBD mutation; execution becomes reviewable only after the SDR-supported control mode and exact payload are supplied and approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, issue one secret-safe raw 0x04 0x28 <sensor> <control> [assertion-mask-LS assertion-mask-MS deassertion-mask-LS deassertion-mask-MS] request using the 2-to-6-byte Table 35-10 form appropriate to the intended control; verify with raw 0x04 0x29 <sensor> and restore the baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: No Master command, sensor or mask is invented; the source TBD and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the control byte and optional mask bytes as one capability-checked transaction, prove the requested event-message/scanning effect without altering adjacent policy layers, and require exact restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a conditional, reversible Review procedure while leaving the original TBD untouched.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A 0x29 read alone does not satisfy this functional write, and PEF routing, event receiver, SEL logging, thresholds and hysteresis remain out of scope.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Disabling event messages can suppress alarms while scanning and internal flags continue; disabling scanning changes sensor status tracking itself.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it exposes the same sensor-scoped global event-message, scanning and individual assertion/deassertion controls with field-level readback and exact restore.
expected_evidence: Owner approval and dedicated target/firmware/channel/sensor/SDR identity
SDR control capability, supported event bits and raw 0x29 baseline
Exact proposed and issued variable-length 0x28 payload
Bounded event-message/scanning observation with preserved logs
Restored baseline and no-change evidence for PEF/event receiver/SEL policy

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title consistently names Set Sensor Event Enable while Procedure and Criteria are TBD. Missing control semantics, masks, oracle and recovery, plus generic log clearing, are source omissions rather than contradictory requirements; the conditional Review procedure leaves the Master TBD unchanged.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard function is identifiable. Sensor capability, exact intended control, mask, stimulus and restore are Project readiness inputs; execution must stop as BLOCKED if they cannot be verified.

review_improvement: Separates global event-message enable, scanning enable and individual event masks, requires the supported variable-length payload, and prevents a successful completion code from hiding monitoring suppression.
independent_technical_reasoning: Table 35-10 can change three different things: all event-message generation, sensor scanning, or selected assertion/deassertion enables. Disabling event messages does not stop internal event flags or scanning, while disabling scanning changes whether status is updated. A safe review must therefore name the exact control mode, validate it against the SDR, observe that specific effect and restore every baseline bit.
